topic_it: Buddha d'oro (Wat Traimit, Bangkok): per 200 anni tutti ci passavano davanti credendolo di gesso, invece era d'oro massiccio (da confermare: ricavato dalla miniatura)
photo_it: Statua dorata del Buddha nel tempio
top: For 200 years, everyone walked past… solid gold, thinking it was just plaster (testo completo non leggibile)

topic_it: Becky, basset hound, arriva da sola di notte in un rifugio sciistico per far cercare il padrone 69enne con demenza: ritrovato vivo il mattino dopo
photo_it: Basset hound al guinzaglio con pettorina arancione
top: Becky the Basset Hound showed up alone at a ski lodge at 9pm. Her owner, 69, has dementia and had gone missing before — so staff called for help.
comment: She walked in alone to get help for him. He was found the next morning, alive.

topic_it: Patrick Stewart si è sposato in un ristorante messicano perché Ian McKellen, che officiava, non poteva celebrare legalmente in Nevada
photo_it: Ian McKellen e Patrick Stewart insieme a un evento
top: Patrick Stewart got married in a Mexican restaurant — because Ian McKellen, who was officiating, wasn't legally allowed to marry them in Nevada.
comment: Gandalf married Captain Picard in a Mexican restaurant. That's the whole story.

topic_it: Voyager 1 è il primo oggetto umano a un giorno-luce dalla Terra (lanciato nel 1977, 16 miliardi di miglia)
photo_it: Illustrazione della sonda Voyager nello spazio
top: NASA's Voyager 1 just became the first human-made object ever to reach one light-day from Earth. Launched in 1977, it's now 16 billion miles away — so far that a radio signal takes a full day to reach it.
comment: Launched in 1977 and still phoning home — it just takes a day for the call to arrive.

topic_it: Petizione da 180.000 firme per riportare Jensen Huang CEO di Nvidia; lui sarebbe 'onorato', il CdA dice no all'unanimità
photo_it: Jensen Huang con il microfono sul palco
top: Over 180,000 people signed a petition to bring Jensen Huang back as Nvidia CEO. He said he'd be "honored" to return. The board said no — unanimously.
comment: He built the company. He resigned. Now everyone wants him back — except the board.

topic_it: I gemelli Jim separati alla nascita: si ritrovano a 39 anni con vite identiche (Linda, Betty, cane Toy, Chevy blu)
photo_it: I due gemelli Jim in bianco e nero
top: Twin brothers separated at birth met again at 39 — and found out they'd lived the EXACT same life. Both named Jim. Both married a Linda, then a Betty. Both had a dog named Toy and drove the same blue Chevy. Coincidence? Science still can't explain it.
comment: Your exact double is out there living your life — and he married a Linda too.
title: Separated at birth, they lived the exact same life
description: Separated at birth, they married women with the same name, named their dogs the same, and lived the same life. #shorts #twins #truestory #facts #viral #zkeyoo

topic_it: Elton John nel film Tommy (1975) come Pinball Wizard con stivali Doc Martens alti 4,5 piedi; tenerli era la sua condizione per il ruolo
photo_it: Elton John con gli stivali giganti sul set + gli stivali esposti
top: In 1975, Elton John played the Pinball Wizard wearing 4-and-a-half-foot Doc Martens boots. He couldn't walk in them — he moved on callipers like stilts. He loved them so much, keeping them was his condition for taking the role.
comment: He told Rod Stewart not to touch the role — then took it himself. In 4.5-foot boots.

topic_it: Xi Jinping va all'aeroporto ad accogliere Trump di persona (prima volta in 14 anni) e lo abbraccia sulla pista
photo_it: Xi Jinping e Trump che si abbracciano sulla pista (2 foto)
top: Xi Jinping did something he hadn't done in 14 years: he went to the airport to greet Trump in person — and hugged him on the tarmac.
comment: He didn't hug Putin when he landed the same day. He hugged Trump.

topic_it: Nicholas Winton salvò 669 bambini dai nazisti nel 1939 e non lo disse a nessuno per 50 anni; nel 1988 alla BBC tutto il pubblico si alza
photo_it: Nicholas Winton anziano + donna commossa nel pubblico della BBC
top: He saved 669 children from the Nazis in 1939 — then told no one for 50 years. In 1988, the BBC sat him in a TV audience. Then the host asked: 'Is there anyone here who owes their life to Nicholas Winton?' The whole room stood up.
comment: He never told a soul. The world found out by accident — 50 years later, live on TV.
